doc: Act III cutscene sounds (M5-A3P-1953): every @sfx the Act III drafts (docs/kb/story/act3/drafts/) name that no other row plays. Thirteen are new (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py, under assets/audio/act3/sfx/, plain git, ADR 0208); four are the drafts' names for the Kite's own foley (sfx_act3.json) and play its files. Same row format as sfx.json; AudioData.sfx_rows merges this file in.

sea_flat_lap._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch17_pulled_from_the_sea: the sea gone flat after the storm, small slow laps on the hull (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

names_murmured._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch18_backs_to_the_water: Haluna saying its dead's names under its breath, many low voices, no word clear (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

clutch_hum._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch18_farewell_tide_taught: the Kirru clutch humming its own line as Asha learns the tune (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

velamir_lullaby_hum._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch18_farewell_tide_taught (Asha) and ending_imra (Imra): the Velamir lullaby hummed, the first verse's first two lines, one woman's closed-mouth voice (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

shell_into_water._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch18_through_the_gate: Pell's old shell into the lagoon: a plunk, a ring of lapping, a clack going down (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

engine_hum_stops._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch19_the_engine_stops: Iskarra's spire engine stopping on the last lever: the bound hum sinking, a ratchet running down, the last knock (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

rope_slips._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch19_the_hitch: Kerrid's hitch spilling on one pull: a soft rip of fibre, the tail running, slack on the planks (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

kite_settles._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch19_the_kite_comes_down: the Kite settling on the drowned plaza: engines idling down, the hull's long creak, rigging slack (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

kite_engine_strains._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch20_down_the_eye: both engines labouring a fifth over idle down the throat, the vanes uneven, the hull complaining (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

kite_touches_floor._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch20_down_the_eye: the keel touching the Undertow's first floor: a deep soft contact, glassy grinding, then still (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

pell_farewell_tide._note: M5-A3P-1953: ch20_nhoa_release: Pell sings the farewell-tide for Nhoa: one low voice on the clutch's rising line (reedhollow CLUTCH) (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

match_struck._note: M5-A3P-1953: ending_first_lamp: Mother Kell's wick lights the first oil lamp: the scratch, the flare, the small flame catching (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

wind_in_sails._note: M5-A3P-1953: ending_the_kite_comes_down: the Kite gliding dark on sail alone: wind in the canvas, the sheets humming (assets_src/sfx/act3_cutscene_sfx.py; plain git, ADR 0208)

kite_engines_stop._note: M5-A3P-1953: the drafts' name for the Kite's own `kite_engine_stop` (kite_foley.py, M3-AUD-859): the same files

sails_fill._note: M5-A3P-1953: the drafts' name for the Kite's own `kite_sail_fill` (kite_foley.py, M3-AUD-859): the same files

rope_creak._note: M5-A3P-1953: the drafts' name for the Kite's own `kite_rope_strain` (kite_foley.py, M3-AUD-859): the same files

hull_meets_water._note: M5-A3P-1953: the drafts' name for the Kite's own `kite_landing` (kite_foley.py, M3-AUD-859): the same files
